doc: v95 swap spec (docs/art/wardens/V95_SWAP.md): Albert's (Mossy, the Breaker) live v95 master, Meshy i1 (~/meshy/v95/Albert/current.json, promoted 11-12 20:35Z: angry porthole eyes, no hammer, shield or drum in the scan) onto breaker.glb's skeleton, clips and anchors; breaker.glb's own hammer mesh (x1.205 at the grip) and shield (kept on x_shield) stay. The swap starts from main's breaker.glb (the clean1 swap): every moved point (`to`, anchors, the screen) is absolute, so nothing is applied twice. Points in the fit frame (his front +Y, his right +X, soles on z 0, the master's metres), read on tools/art1/v95_grid.py's renders and slice profiles; i1 stands ~0.12 m forward of its origin, so the pelvis sits at y 0.12. The pelvis stays at the rig's hips height (k 1: the girth keeps the master's); the masts and sails ride the hips, the helmet the head, the fish hangs from his left mast on x_fish, the porthole glass is the mood face's screen (eyes-mood: shaders/warden_mood.gdshader draws i1's slanted eyes) and the painted cyan cracks glow (`emit_paint`: the master has no emission map, so `emit` would bake the base colour as glow: the 11-12 solid cyan).
